Definition: to free, separate; figuratively, to unravel, commence; by implication (of unloading beasts) to reside
BiblicalUsage: Daniel uses this word for unravelling what is hidden: God reveals the deep and secret things, and Ezra uses it for the prophets who lent their help when the rebuilding began.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe only God unravels the deep things, and when He does, His people can get back to the work.
